meta.title: Promise of Farewell
meta.description: The shining firmament splits open, casting a distinct shadow.

units.rawText: In an unknown place, at an unknown time.
units.displayText: In an unknown place, at an unknown time.

spans.text: In an unknown place, at an unknown time.

units.rawText: The crushing silence and darkness all around me make my consciousness feel like it's going to disintegrate, like a ball of weeds thrown into the water. Even when I come to my senses, my mind feels like drifting foam.
units.displayText: The crushing silence and darkness all around me make my consciousness feel like it's going to disintegrate, like a ball of weeds thrown into the water. Even when I come to my senses, my mind feels like drifting foam.

spans.text: The crushing silence and darkness all around me make my consciousness feel like it's going to disintegrate, like a ball of weeds thrown into the water. Even when I come to my senses, my mind feels like drifting foam.

units.rawText: (Whispering and rustling)
units.displayText: (Whispering and rustling)

spans.text: (Whispering and rustling)

units.rawText: Voices seem to be peering around a corner, nervously looking to either side. Then, as though they know the caged protagonist can do nothing to impede them, they begin growing bolder, more arrogant.
units.displayText: Voices seem to be peering around a corner, nervously looking to either side. Then, as though they know the caged protagonist can do nothing to impede them, they begin growing bolder, more arrogant.

spans.text: Voices seem to be peering around a corner, nervously looking to either side. Then, as though they know the caged protagonist can do nothing to impede them, they begin growing bolder, more arrogant.

units.rawText: The voices' contents are indistinct, with words displaced and transposed. They are not there to convey information or meaning, but rather, they are more like a shackle that came loose by chance. Since they have no power to conceal the secret behind them, they have no choice but to let it all loose.
units.displayText: The voices' contents are indistinct, with words displaced and transposed. They are not there to convey information or meaning, but rather, they are more like a shackle that came loose by chance. Since they have no power to conceal the secret behind them, they have no choice but to let it all loose.

spans.text: The voices' contents are indistinct, with words displaced and transposed. They are not there to convey information or meaning, but rather, they are more like a shackle that came loose by chance. Since they have no power to conceal the secret behind them, they have no choice but to let it all loose.

units.rawText: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain ill-effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.
units.displayText: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain ill-effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.

spans.text: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain ill-effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.

units.rawText: Memory loss again...
units.displayText: Memory loss again...

spans.text: Memory loss again...

units.rawText: Also, while I will do my best to ensure your safe connection, if you end up dying in the fragment's memory data, you might end up being lost in the data turbulence forever, never to wake up again.
units.displayText: Also, while I will do my best to ensure your safe connection, if you end up dying in the fragment's memory data, you might end up being lost in the data turbulence forever, never to wake up again.

spans.text: Also, while I will do my best to ensure your safe connection, if you end up dying in the fragment's memory data, you might end up being lost in the data turbulence forever, never to wake up again.

units.rawText: That's fine. After all, this is a much better situation than I envisioned.
units.displayText: That's fine. After all, this is a much better situation than I envisioned.

spans.text: That's fine. After all, this is a much better situation than I envisioned.

units.rawText: ...Who's that?
units.displayText: ...Who's that?

spans.text: ...Who's that?

units.rawText: Sorry... I'm fine, just that my memories are a mess. Why am I here?
units.displayText: Sorry... I'm fine, just that my memories are a mess. Why am I here?

spans.text: Sorry... I'm fine, just that my memories are a mess. Why am I here?

units.rawText: ...Please stop your self-diagnostic for now. I'm worried that it'll cause errors in your neural cloud systems.
units.displayText: ...Please stop your self-diagnostic for now. I'm worried that it'll cause errors in your neural cloud systems.

spans.text: ...Please stop your self-diagnostic for now. I'm worried that it'll cause errors in your neural cloud systems.

units.rawText: An exposed neural cloud in a place like the Tartarus Sector is like a light in the night, drawing predators to itself.
units.displayText: An exposed neural cloud in a place like the Tartarus Sector is like a light in the night, drawing predators to itself.

spans.text: An exposed neural cloud in a place like the Tartarus Sector is like a light in the night, drawing predators to itself.

units.rawText: I'll take you to meet the others and then explain the situation to you in more detail.
units.displayText: I'll take you to meet the others and then explain the situation to you in more detail.

spans.text: I'll take you to meet the others and then explain the situation to you in more detail.

units.rawText: What are they talking about?
units.displayText: What are they talking about?

spans.text: What are they talking about?

units.rawText: The overlapping voices come and go as they wish, speaking with no concern for my questions. Perhaps the reason why they appeared was to fill me with confusion.
units.displayText: The overlapping voices come and go as they wish, speaking with no concern for my questions. Perhaps the reason why they appeared was to fill me with confusion.

spans.text: The overlapping voices come and go as they wish, speaking with no concern for my questions. Perhaps the reason why they appeared was to fill me with confusion.

units.rawText: As the voices fade away, the crushing sensation fades, and my dark prison welcomes its first ray of dawn.
units.displayText: As the voices fade away, the crushing sensation fades, and my dark prison welcomes its first ray of dawn.

spans.text: As the voices fade away, the crushing sensation fades, and my dark prison welcomes its first ray of dawn.

units.rawText: <cmdr>...
Ugh...
units.displayText: Ugh...

spans.text: Ugh...

units.rawText: <cmdr>?
units.displayText: {교수}?

units.rawText: ...Eos?
units.displayText: ...Eos?

spans.text: ...Eos?

units.rawText: Noble <cmdr>, I am the Intermediate Sanctifier Love of the Clergy. How do you feel now?
units.displayText: Noble {교수}, I am the Intermediate Sanctifier Love of the Clergy. How do you feel now?

spans.text: Noble
, I am the Intermediate Sanctifier Love of the Clergy. How do you feel now?

units.rawText: The Clergy...? Shouldn't I be in Tartarus...
units.displayText: The Clergy...? Shouldn't I be in Tartarus...

spans.text: The Clergy...? Shouldn't I be in Tartarus...

units.rawText: That's right... Malkira... Eosphorus!
units.displayText: That's right... Malkira... Eosphorus!

spans.text: That's right... Malkira... Eosphorus!

units.rawText: Clink—
units.displayText: Clink—

spans.text: Clink—

units.rawText: I reflexively try to move after waking up, only to find that something is binding my body.
units.displayText: I reflexively try to move after waking up, only to find that something is binding my body.

spans.text: I reflexively try to move after waking up, only to find that something is binding my body.

units.rawText: My apologies, but I hope you will not move around since you are still recovering.
units.displayText: My apologies, but I hope you will not move around since you are still recovering.

spans.text: My apologies, but I hope you will not move around since you are still recovering.

units.rawText: This is not the frontline. We are currently in the Reverse Tower of Babylon and this is the Chamber of Divine Restoration, presided over by the clergy. It is a place where Sanctifiers undergo treatment and recovery.
units.displayText: This is not the frontline. We are currently in the Reverse Tower of Babylon and this is the Chamber of Divine Restoration, presided over by the clergy. It is a place where Sanctifiers undergo treatment and recovery.

spans.text: This is not the frontline. We are currently in the Reverse Tower of Babylon and this is the Chamber of Divine Restoration, presided over by the clergy. It is a place where Sanctifiers undergo treatment and recovery.

units.rawText: We are safe, so please calm yourself. I will release you from your bonds now.
units.displayText: We are safe, so please calm yourself. I will release you from your bonds now.

spans.text: We are safe, so please calm yourself. I will release you from your bonds now.

units.rawText: The Intermediate Sanctifier called Love performs an operation beside me and the restrictions all over my body suddenly loosen.
units.displayText: The Intermediate Sanctifier called Love performs an operation beside me and the restrictions all over my body suddenly loosen.

spans.text: The Intermediate Sanctifier called Love performs an operation beside me and the restrictions all over my body suddenly loosen.

units.rawText: Could you tell me what's going on? How did I come back from Tartarus?
units.displayText: Could you tell me what's going on? How did I come back from Tartarus?

spans.text: Could you tell me what's going on? How did I come back from Tartarus?

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus brought you back. You have been resting for half a month now.
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus brought you back. You have been resting for half a month now.

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus brought you back. You have been resting for half a month now.

units.rawText: Half a month?
units.displayText: Half a month?

spans.text: Half a month?

units.rawText: Uneasiness spreads throughout me. I bring up my system journal, which indicates that it's been half a month since our infiltration of Tartarus.
units.displayText: Uneasiness spreads throughout me. I bring up my system journal, which indicates that it's been half a month since our infiltration of Tartarus.

spans.text: Uneasiness spreads throughout me. I bring up my system journal, which indicates that it's been half a month since our infiltration of Tartarus.

units.rawText: Since Eosphorus sent me back... Where is he now?
units.displayText: Since Eosphorus sent me back... Where is he now?

spans.text: Since Eosphorus sent me back... Where is he now?

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus has left. As you know, we Intermediate Sanctifiers are not authorized to pry into the affairs of the Greater Ones without a good reason.
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus has left. As you know, we Intermediate Sanctifiers are not authorized to pry into the affairs of the Greater Ones without a good reason.

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus has left. As you know, we Intermediate Sanctifiers are not authorized to pry into the affairs of the Greater Ones without a good reason.

units.rawText: However, Lord Eosphorus left an encrypted message for you in the Chamber of Divine Restoration before he left. Would you like me to hand it over to you now, or would you prefer to wait? You appear to be unwell, so I would advise you to rest...
units.displayText: However, Lord Eosphorus left an encrypted message for you in the Chamber of Divine Restoration before he left. Would you like me to hand it over to you now, or would you prefer to wait? You appear to be unwell, so I would advise you to rest...

spans.text: However, Lord Eosphorus left an encrypted message for you in the Chamber of Divine Restoration before he left. Would you like me to hand it over to you now, or would you prefer to wait? You appear to be unwell, so I would advise you to rest...

units.rawText: That's fine. Just send the message over now.
units.displayText: That's fine. Just send the message over now.

spans.text: That's fine. Just send the message over now.

units.rawText: After exiting the recovery capsule, I limber up my body and get used to the situation. I feel a strange sense of curiosity regarding the Intermediate Sanctifier before me.
units.displayText: After exiting the recovery capsule, I limber up my body and get used to the situation. I feel a strange sense of curiosity regarding the Intermediate Sanctifier before me.

spans.text: After exiting the recovery capsule, I limber up my body and get used to the situation. I feel a strange sense of curiosity regarding the Intermediate Sanctifier before me.

units.rawText: Have you been here all this time?
units.displayText: Have you been here all this time?

spans.text: Have you been here all this time?

units.rawText: Yes, I have. Your safety is of great importance to the Reverse Tower. Lord Eosphorus sent me here to care for you after he brought you here.
units.displayText: Yes, I have. Your safety is of great importance to the Reverse Tower. Lord Eosphorus sent me here to care for you after he brought you here.

spans.text: Yes, I have. Your safety is of great importance to the Reverse Tower. Lord Eosphorus sent me here to care for you after he brought you here.

units.rawText: ...Have I seen you before?
units.displayText: ...Have I seen you before?

spans.text: ...Have I seen you before?

units.rawText: It has not been long since I was born from my Sacred Canon, and I was under Lord Eosphorus' direct command before this, so I believe you should not have seen me before.
units.displayText: It has not been long since I was born from my Sacred Canon, and I was under Lord Eosphorus' direct command before this, so I believe you should not have seen me before.

spans.text: It has not been long since I was born from my Sacred Canon, and I was under Lord Eosphorus' direct command before this, so I believe you should not have seen me before.

units.rawText: So I've never seen you before... hng?!
units.displayText: So I've never seen you before... hng?!

spans.text: So I've never seen you before... hng?!

units.rawText: An image flashes across my neural cloud like an electric shock; it seems to have come from a long time ago, or perhaps a long time in the future.
units.displayText: An image flashes across my neural cloud like an electric shock; it seems to have come from a long time ago, or perhaps a long time in the future.

spans.text: An image flashes across my neural cloud like an electric shock; it seems to have come from a long time ago, or perhaps a long time in the future.

units.rawText: Are you alright? We detected damage to your memory module during the recovery. I advise you perform a deep self-diagnostic.
units.displayText: Are you alright? We detected damage to your memory module during the recovery. I advise you perform a deep self-diagnostic.

spans.text: Are you alright? We detected damage to your memory module during the recovery. I advise you perform a deep self-diagnostic.

units.rawText: No... It's alright.
units.displayText: No... It's alright.

spans.text: No... It's alright.

units.rawText: I finally realize that this strange curiosity doesn't come from my own perceptions as a Sanctifier, but from something else that I've overlooked...
units.displayText: I finally realize that this strange curiosity doesn't come from my own perceptions as a Sanctifier, but from something else that I've overlooked...

spans.text: I finally realize that this strange curiosity doesn't come from my own perceptions as a Sanctifier, but from something else that I've overlooked...

units.rawText: ...What kind of message did Eosphorus leave behind?
units.displayText: ...What kind of message did Eosphorus leave behind?

spans.text: ...What kind of message did Eosphorus leave behind?

units.rawText: Now loading encrypted message contents... Noble <cmdr>, this requires vocal recognition from you. All you need to do is say "acknowledged".
units.displayText: Now loading encrypted message contents... Noble {교수}, this requires vocal recognition from you. All you need to do is say "acknowledged".

spans.text: Now loading encrypted message contents... Noble
, this requires vocal recognition from you. All you need to do is say "acknowledged".

units.rawText: Acknowledged.
units.displayText: Acknowledged.

spans.text: Acknowledged.

units.rawText: Vocal recognition confirmed. Neural cloud is a match. Physical verification complete. Now decrypting encrypted message...
units.displayText: Vocal recognition confirmed. Neural cloud is a match. Physical verification complete. Now decrypting encrypted message...

spans.text: Vocal recognition confirmed. Neural cloud is a match. Physical verification complete. Now decrypting encrypted message...

units.rawText: I will be off then. Please feel free to contact me if you need anything.
units.displayText: I will be off then. Please feel free to contact me if you need anything.

spans.text: I will be off then. Please feel free to contact me if you need anything.

units.rawText: Love bows and then leaves the Chamber of Restoration. The only thing I can see now is Eosphorus' message.
units.displayText: Love bows and then leaves the Chamber of Restoration. The only thing I can see now is Eosphorus' message.

spans.text: Love bows and then leaves the Chamber of Restoration. The only thing I can see now is Eosphorus' message.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, I know you must have many questions for me. But do not worry; we have already returned to the Reverse Tower and it is safe now.
units.displayText: {교수}, I know you must have many questions for me. But do not worry; we have already returned to the Reverse Tower and it is safe now.

spans.text: , I know you must have many questions for me. But do not worry; we have already returned to the Reverse Tower and it is safe now.

units.rawText: Many problems have piled up at the frontlines due to this operation, so I must return there to clear them up.
units.displayText: Many problems have piled up at the frontlines due to this operation, so I must return there to clear them up.

spans.text: Many problems have piled up at the frontlines due to this operation, so I must return there to clear them up.

units.rawText: Before I return, you should have a good rest. Let Love know if you need anything.
units.displayText: Before I return, you should have a good rest. Let Love know if you need anything.

spans.text: Before I return, you should have a good rest. Let Love know if you need anything.

units.rawText: As for the rest... Once I return and we meet again, I will tell you everything.
units.displayText: As for the rest... Once I return and we meet again, I will tell you everything.

spans.text: As for the rest... Once I return and we meet again, I will tell you everything.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: The image vanishes. I stroke my chin and narrow my eyes.
units.displayText: The image vanishes. I stroke my chin and narrow my eyes.

spans.text: The image vanishes. I stroke my chin and narrow my eyes.

units.rawText: Memories well up in my mind.
units.displayText: Memories well up in my mind.

spans.text: Memories well up in my mind.

units.rawText: Alright... just the... of us now...
units.displayText: Alright... just the... of us now...

spans.text: Alright... just the... of us now...

units.rawText: Work together... resist...
units.displayText: Work together... resist...

spans.text: Work together... resist...

units.rawText: Atlas... Ele... Al... cores... remain...
units.displayText: Atlas... Ele... Al... cores... remain...

spans.text: Atlas... Ele... Al... cores... remain...

units.rawText: Resurrection... possible... cooperation... sincerity...
units.displayText: Resurrection... possible... cooperation... sincerity...

spans.text: Resurrection... possible... cooperation... sincerity...

units.rawText: That's why you had to return to the frontline... Is that really it, Eosphorus?
units.displayText: That's why you had to return to the frontline... Is that really it, Eosphorus?

spans.text: That's why you had to return to the frontline... Is that really it, Eosphorus?

units.rawText: After I string together the sequence of events, I try to read my memory modules again, and after several failed attempts at connecting to them, I finally manage to play back the scraps of info I heard before my neural cloud rebooted.
units.displayText: After I string together the sequence of events, I try to read my memory modules again, and after several failed attempts at connecting to them, I finally manage to play back the scraps of info I heard before my neural cloud rebooted.

spans.text: After I string together the sequence of events, I try to read my memory modules again, and after several failed attempts at connecting to them, I finally manage to play back the scraps of info I heard before my neural cloud rebooted.

units.rawText: Although it's still disjointed, it finally gives me an idea regarding what to do in this situation.
units.displayText: Although it's still disjointed, it finally gives me an idea regarding what to do in this situation.

spans.text: Although it's still disjointed, it finally gives me an idea regarding what to do in this situation.

units.rawText: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain ill-effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.
units.displayText: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain ill-effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.

spans.text: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain ill-effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.

units.rawText: Memory module, memory module...
units.displayText: Memory module, memory module...

spans.text: Memory module, memory module...

units.rawText: <size=40>Love!</size>
units.displayText: Love!

spans.text: Love!

units.rawText: I'm here. What do you need?
units.displayText: I'm here. What do you need?

spans.text: I'm here. What do you need?

units.rawText: Can the Chamber of Divine Restoration heal memory damage?
units.displayText: Can the Chamber of Divine Restoration heal memory damage?

spans.text: Can the Chamber of Divine Restoration heal memory damage?

units.rawText: Of course it can. The Chamber of Divine Restoration is an area dedicated to the very concept of healing. Please do not doubt our professional skills.
units.displayText: Of course it can. The Chamber of Divine Restoration is an area dedicated to the very concept of healing. Please do not doubt our professional skills.

spans.text: Of course it can. The Chamber of Divine Restoration is an area dedicated to the very concept of healing. Please do not doubt our professional skills.

units.rawText: There is no better healing facility than this in all of Magrasea. With your permission, we will begin the recovery work immediately.
units.displayText: There is no better healing facility than this in all of Magrasea. With your permission, we will begin the recovery work immediately.

spans.text: There is no better healing facility than this in all of Magrasea. With your permission, we will begin the recovery work immediately.

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you, then.
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you, then.

spans.text: I'll be counting on you, then.

units.rawText: I look thoughtfully at Love, and as I narrow my eyes, data flies across them at high speed.
units.displayText: I look thoughtfully at Love, and as I narrow my eyes, data flies across them at high speed.

spans.text: I look thoughtfully at Love, and as I narrow my eyes, data flies across them at high speed.

units.rawText: In the Admin Center of the Enigma Sector.
units.displayText: In the Admin Center of the Enigma Sector.

spans.text: In the Admin Center of the Enigma Sector.

units.rawText: The sound of rapid keystrokes fills the room. If one had to assign some musical accompaniment to this frenzied typing, the only piece that would fit would be the Flight of the Bumblebee.
units.displayText: The sound of rapid keystrokes fills the room. If one had to assign some musical accompaniment to this frenzied typing, the only piece that would fit would be the Flight of the Bumblebee.

spans.text: The sound of rapid keystrokes fills the room. If one had to assign some musical accompaniment to this frenzied typing, the only piece that would fit would be the Flight of the Bumblebee.

units.rawText: Antonina follows the clues that Eos gave, and after going around in circles a few times and jumping between different pieces of past information, her fingertip stops on a certain spot.
units.displayText: Antonina follows the clues that Eos gave, and after going around in circles a few times and jumping between different pieces of past information, her fingertip stops on a certain spot.

spans.text: Antonina follows the clues that Eos gave, and after going around in circles a few times and jumping between different pieces of past information, her fingertip stops on a certain spot.

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: A massive impact drowns out all the noise in the room. Antonina suddenly stands up, leaving her table and chairs shaking from the force of her movements.
units.displayText: A massive impact drowns out all the noise in the room. Antonina suddenly stands up, leaving her table and chairs shaking from the force of her movements.

spans.text: A massive impact drowns out all the noise in the room. Antonina suddenly stands up, leaving her table and chairs shaking from the force of her movements.

units.rawText: I've found it! Neumann, help me contact Persicaria!
units.displayText: I've found it! Neumann, help me contact Persicaria!

spans.text: I've found it! Neumann, help me contact Persicaria!

units.rawText: Whew, I thought someone was hacking us... Now connecting...
units.displayText: Whew, I thought someone was hacking us... Now connecting...

spans.text: Whew, I thought someone was hacking us... Now connecting...

units.rawText: Neumann wipes away the coffee that splashed on him with a paper towel, not pausing for a moment as he continues streaming the screen from just now to Persicaria's view feed.
units.displayText: Neumann wipes away the coffee that splashed on him with a paper towel, not pausing for a moment as he continues streaming the screen from just now to Persicaria's view feed.

spans.text: Neumann wipes away the coffee that splashed on him with a paper towel, not pausing for a moment as he continues streaming the screen from just now to Persicaria's view feed.

units.rawText: This is Persicaria, I'm preparing for combat practice after the upgrade. How is it, Antonina? Have you found the Professor yet?
units.displayText: This is Persicaria, I'm preparing for combat practice after the upgrade. How is it, Antonina? Have you found the Professor yet?

spans.text: This is Persicaria, I'm preparing for combat practice after the upgrade. How is it, Antonina? Have you found the Professor yet?

units.rawText: We've pinpointed a precise time and location. Get ready, we're assembling coordinates for the output terminal...
units.displayText: We've pinpointed a precise time and location. Get ready, we're assembling coordinates for the output terminal...

spans.text: We've pinpointed a precise time and location. Get ready, we're assembling coordinates for the output terminal...

units.rawText: Hold on, Anna! The upgrade isn't complete yet! The loading phase is only 99% complete, and we still have one more step to go after that. Also, Persicaria will need time to get familiar with fighting after the upgrade is done.
units.displayText: Hold on, Anna! The upgrade isn't complete yet! The loading phase is only 99% complete, and we still have one more step to go after that. Also, Persicaria will need time to get familiar with fighting after the upgrade is done.

spans.text: Hold on, Anna! The upgrade isn't complete yet! The loading phase is only 99% complete, and we still have one more step to go after that. Also, Persicaria will need time to get familiar with fighting after the upgrade is done.

units.rawText: No, we don't have time for that. The fragment is on the verge of collapse; this forced intervention might be the only chance we get.
units.displayText: No, we don't have time for that. The fragment is on the verge of collapse; this forced intervention might be the only chance we get.

spans.text: No, we don't have time for that. The fragment is on the verge of collapse; this forced intervention might be the only chance we get.

units.rawText: Are you okay with this, Persicaria?
units.displayText: Are you okay with this, Persicaria?

spans.text: Are you okay with this, Persicaria?

units.rawText: ...Don't worry. Experience is the best teacher.
units.displayText: ...Don't worry. Experience is the best teacher.

spans.text: ...Don't worry. Experience is the best teacher.

units.rawText: Persicaria tightens her grip around her sword. Her eyes are steady and certain.
units.displayText: Persicaria tightens her grip around her sword. Her eyes are steady and certain.

spans.text: Persicaria tightens her grip around her sword. Her eyes are steady and certain.

units.rawText: I'll leave the outside to you. Just leave the fighting to me.
units.displayText: I'll leave the outside to you. Just leave the fighting to me.

spans.text: I'll leave the outside to you. Just leave the fighting to me.

units.rawText: You guys... (Sigh)
units.displayText: You guys... (Sigh)

spans.text: You guys... (Sigh)

units.rawText: After seeing Persicaria's comm image blink off, Neumann groans in resignation before returning to his work.
units.displayText: After seeing Persicaria's comm image blink off, Neumann groans in resignation before returning to his work.

spans.text: After seeing Persicaria's comm image blink off, Neumann groans in resignation before returning to his work.

units.rawText: Establishing transmission channel... But it's still too risky.
units.displayText: Establishing transmission channel... But it's still too risky.

spans.text: Establishing transmission channel... But it's still too risky.

units.rawText: What if Persicaria drops packets when we're sending her over? If she ends up missing an arm or a leg...
units.displayText: What if Persicaria drops packets when we're sending her over? If she ends up missing an arm or a leg...

spans.text: What if Persicaria drops packets when we're sending her over? If she ends up missing an arm or a leg...

units.rawText: That won't happen. The upgrade program is distinct from the main body. At the very least, she might lose her combat modules, but she'll be fine.
units.displayText: That won't happen. The upgrade program is distinct from the main body. At the very least, she might lose her combat modules, but she'll be fine.

spans.text: That won't happen. The upgrade program is distinct from the main body. At the very least, she might lose her combat modules, but she'll be fine.

units.rawText: But dropping packets from the combat modules is really dangerous, too! If she ends up in the midst of the enemy while unarmed...
